target_customer: Revenue teams and sales managers who want reps to practice calls before live deals
problem: Reps rehearse poorly and managers cannot see readiness. Quotain simulates AI buyers built from the playbook, CRM context and past calls, scores sessions and shows coaching priorities.
business_model: B2B SaaS per seat: Starter $50 and Pro $100 per seat per month with 7-day trial

founders.name: Alexander Talamonti
founders.background_notes: YC page says the founders are engineers who had to learn sales the hard way; individual backgrounds not stated.

competitors.name: Yoodli
competitors.what: AI roleplay practice for sales teams, with feedback on pitches and objection handling

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time voice agents with scoring and CRM and call-data integrations; mostly assembled from model APIs with some hard latency and evaluation work.

defensibility.rationale: Workspace-specific buyer personas and integrations add some lock-in, but many vendors offer roleplay.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established roleplay and enablement vendors existed; no acquisition of Quotain found.

market_need_then: Vendor comparison pages show a crowded roleplay category, indicating spend on sales training, though those pages are mostly vendor blogs and undated.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain product language with a Trust Center

rebrands.why: Dealroom says the legal entity Eden AI, Inc. does business as Quotain, formerly Eden; reason not stated

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found and a prior name suggests an early rename.

outcome_analysis: Quotain is an active two person New York company selling AI sales roleplay in a crowded category with funded rivals. Public pricing and a MCP integration exist, but funding is unverified and no outcome event was found, so its trajectory is unclear.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked says $500K pre-seed (July 2025) from YC; Dealroom shows a $125K seed tagged as support program. Aggregators only, so no round recorded. Competitor search returned only vendor blogs without Quotain and undated, a later search found one dated competitor, Yoodli (company post 2025-05-20, the month before the as_of date). Hyperbound and Second Nature also sell AI sales roleplay but their funding announcements fall after the batch (September and October 2025), so they are not listed. Founder technical flag is based on the YC description of engineers. Former name: Neuronfeed lists a company called Eden that went through YC Summer 2025 and says the product is operated under the Quotain brand, and the legal entity is reported as Eden AI, Inc.; the YC launch post does not mention Eden and no source dates the rename, so Eden is recorded here as a probable former name and not as a confirmed one. Round added: VCBacked reports a $500K pre-seed in July 2025 from Y Combinator; this rests on a single database (Dealroom shows a conflicting $125K seed, not recorded, and no press release was found). A cross-check search found no other source.
